title: Kinetics Harvesting Tile (KHT) Green Runway
synopsis:
The Kinetic Harvesting Tile (KHT) Green Runway is an urban sustainability innovation that converts everyday footsteps into usable electricity through piezoelectric flooring. To address the common limitation of low power output in piezoelectric energy harvesting systems, the project incorporated several design enhancements, including rubber stoppers, mechanical spacers, stacked piezoelectric modules, and a modular structure that allows individual base units to be combined for higher output based on application needs.

These improvements enabled practical and engaging applications at ITE College West, such as kinetic hopscotch, emergency lighting, and an interactive game station for sustainability education and outreach. The innovation was also documented in the IntechOpen book chapter, Maximising Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting: Overcoming Challenges and Unlocking Sustainable Power Generation, extended to Virogreen Singapore's E-Waste Visitor Centre through an industry collaboration.
shortSynopsis: The Kinetic Harvesting Tile (KHT) Green Runway is an urban sustainability innovation that converts everyday footsteps into usable electricity through piezoelectric flooring. To address the common limitation of low power output in piezoelectric energy harvesting systems, the project incorporated several design enhancements, including rubber stoppers, mechanical spacers, stacked piezoelectric modules, and a modular structure that allows individual base units to be combined for higher output based on application needs.
innovation: Introduces a modular kinetic energy harvesting tile system that combines stacked piezoelectric modules, mechanical spacers, and shock-absorbing rubber stoppers to maximize electrical output from pedestrian footsteps. The design allows individual base units to be expanded or customized according to application requirements, improving durability, scalability, and energy generation efficiency for educational and urban sustainability applications.
benefit: Converts otherwise wasted human kinetic energy into renewable electrical power, providing a sustainable and low-cost energy source for applications such as hopscotch games, emergency lighting, and interactive educational exhibits. The project promotes environmental awareness, supports sustainability education, and demonstrates practical green energy solutions that can be deployed in schools, public spaces, and outreach centres such as Virogreen Singapore's E-Waste Visitor Centre.

title: Smart Recycling Machine
synopsis:
Conventional e-waste bins lack real-time monitoring capabilities, leading to inefficient collection schedules, unnecessary trips, and limited operational visibility. While smart recycling machines address these gaps through IoT-enabled monitoring, automated alerts, and user incentive features, they remain dependent on grid electricity. This reliance increases operating costs, restricts deployment flexibility, and weakens the overall sustainability proposition, particularly for outdoor, mobile, or temporary installations.

To overcome these limitations, ITE collaborated with its industry partner to enhance the existing smart recycling machine by integrating a solar-powered energy system. This transformation created a Sustainable Smart Machine capable of supporting off-grid operation, more flexible deployment, and a stronger alignment with circular economy and sustainability goals.
shortSynopsis: Conventional e-waste bins lack real-time monitoring capabilities, leading to inefficient collection schedules, unnecessary trips, and limited operational visibility. While smart recycling machines address these gaps through IoT-enabled monitoring, automated alerts, and user incentive features, they remain dependent on grid electricity.
innovation: Integrates IoT-enabled real-time monitoring, automated collection alerts, and user engagement features into a smart e-waste recycling platform. The system can be enhanced with renewable energy sources such as solar power to reduce reliance on grid electricity, enabling flexible deployment in outdoor, mobile, and temporary locations. By combining operational monitoring with sustainability-focused design, the machine improves collection efficiency while promoting responsible e-waste disposal through an interactive user experience.
benefit: Improves operational efficiency by providing real-time fill-level visibility and reducing unnecessary collection trips, leading to lower manpower and transportation costs. The renewable energy capability enhances deployment flexibility and sustainability, while the user incentive and awareness features encourage greater public participation in e-waste recycling. This contributes to increased e-waste diversion from landfills, supports environmental education, and promotes a circular economy approach to resource recovery.

title: AI Beverage
synopsis:
Many commercial beverages today are packed with excessive sugar, artificial additives, and are sold in non-eco-friendly packaging. These factors contribute to serious health concerns such as obesity, diabetes, and other lifestyle-related diseases, while also worsening environmental pollution through plastic waste and carbon emissions. As a result, both human well-being and ecological balance are at risk, creating long-term social and environmental costs.

Addressing this issue is crucial to promote healthier lifestyles, reduce the global burden of diet-related illnesses, and support environmental sustainability. Consumers are increasingly seeking healthier and more ethical choices, yet there remains a lack of accessible and sustainable beverage options. By developing innovative, technology-driven solutions that focus on nutrition and eco-friendly production, we can close this market gap and contribute to a healthier population and a more sustainable planet.
shortSynopsis: Many commercial beverages today are packed with excessive sugar, artificial additives, and are sold in non-eco-friendly packaging. These factors contribute to serious health concerns such as obesity, diabetes, and other lifestyle-related diseases, while also worsening environmental pollution through plastic waste and carbon emissions.
innovation:
Project AI Beverage introduces a technology-driven approach to developing healthier and more sustainable beverages by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI), personalised nutrition, and eco-conscious production. Unlike conventional beverages that often rely on high sugar content, artificial additives, and environmentally harmful packaging, the project aims to leverage AI to analyse consumer preferences and nutritional needs to support the creation of healthier, lower-sugar beverage options.

The innovation also extends beyond the beverage itself by incorporating sustainable ingredients, production methods, and eco-friendly packaging to minimise environmental impact. By combining AI-enabled personalisation with health-focused formulation and sustainability, Project AI Beverage offers a new model for developing beverages that address both consumer well-being and environmental responsibility.

This integrated approach creates a smarter, healthier, and more sustainable beverage solution, bridging the gap between emerging technology, nutrition, consumer demand, and environmental sustainability.
benefit:
Project AI Beverage delivers benefits across health, technology, business, and environmental sustainability:

Healthier Choices – Promotes lower-sugar and more nutritious beverage options, supporting healthier lifestyles and reducing the risks associated with excessive sugar consumption.
Personalised Nutrition – Uses AI to analyse consumer preferences and nutritional needs, enabling more personalised beverage recommendations and formulations.
Environmental Sustainability – Encourages the use of sustainable ingredients, eco-friendly packaging, and greener production processes to reduce plastic waste and carbon emissions.
Consumer Awareness – Helps consumers make more informed decisions by providing greater visibility into beverage ingredients, nutritional value, and sustainability.
Market Innovation – Addresses the growing demand for healthier and environmentally responsible beverages while creating opportunities for new products and business models.
Technology Adoption – Demonstrates how AI can be applied beyond traditional industries to solve real-world health, consumer, and environmental challenges.
Long-Term Social Impact – Contributes to healthier communities and a more sustainable environment by addressing both lifestyle-related health concerns and ecological challenges.

title: Pulse Edge AI with EcoPulse Insight
shortTitle: Pulse Edge AI with EcoPulse Insight
synopsis: Pulse Edge AI with EcoPulse Insight is a smart-energy monitoring and investigation system that combines TinyML edge intelligence with an AI-guided Investigation Assistant. Electrical measurements are analysed directly on an ESP32-S3, where TinyML classifies operating conditions as Idle, Low, Medium or High Load using electrical measurements and time context. EcoPulse Insight complements this edge intelligence by helping users understand the findings, ask questions about energy behaviour and identify what should be investigated or verified. The system turns raw energy data into understandable insights while keeping humans responsible for operational decisions.
shortSynopsis: Pulse Edge AI with EcoPulse Insight is a smart-energy monitoring and investigation system that combines TinyML edge intelligence with an AI-guided Investigation Assistant. Electrical measurements are analysed directly on an ESP32-S3, where TinyML classifies operating conditions as Idle, Low, Medium or High Load using electrical measurements and time context.
innovation:
The innovation lies in combining local TinyML classification with evidence-grounded conversational AI. Instead of only displaying electrical readings, Pulse Edge AI adds time context and classifies load conditions directly on the ESP32-S3, allowing core intelligence to operate locally without relying on cloud connectivity. EcoPulse Insight then provides a conversational investigation layer that explains measured findings and guides users on what to verify, while deterministic measurements and analytics remain the source of truth. 

This creates a trusted workflow of Measure → Classify → Explain → Investigate → Verify → Decide.
benefit: Pulse Edge AI with EcoPulse Insight transforms electrical telemetry into understandable, actionable energy intelligence. Local TinyML classifies load conditions with time context, helping users identify potentially unusual operating patterns earlier while continuing to work without cloud connectivity. EcoPulse Insight builds on this evidence by guiding users through investigation, possible explanations and verification of legitimate operational needs before action is taken. Users can also simulate potential energy-saving scenarios and estimate their possible energy, cost and carbon impact before making operational changes. By combining edge intelligence, evidence-grounded AI guidance and human verification, the system supports earlier awareness, more focused investigation and informed action while ensuring that AI assists rather than replaces human decision-making.

title: ITE Chow
synopsis: ITE Chow is basically like a Grab app but custom-made for our campus to help us skip the crazy long lunch lines and save time, especially for those staying back late for CCAs. Just like ordering self-collection on Grab, we can just open the app, look through the canteen menus, and order our food with one click. What makes it super cool is that we are using AI to look at how busy the stalls are and give us an accurate estimated waiting time, so we know exactly when to walk over and grab our food instead of standing around waiting. For the aunties and uncles running the stalls, the app works like a vendor terminal to help them manage orders easily and clear the crowd, making lunchtime way better for everyone at CW.
shortSynopsis: ITE Chow is basically like a Grab app but custom-made for our campus to help us skip the crazy long lunch lines and save time, especially for those staying back late for CCAs. Administrators: Have access to backend tools to manage users, oversee stalls, and generate platform reports.

Implementing the HawkerHub system offers several distinct advantages for both the customers/students and the canteen vendors:
a. Reduced Queue Lengths: By allowing advance ordering, the platform minimizes physical lines and relieves overcrowding at the stalls. 
b. Time Savings: Students recover valuable rest and learning time that is typically lost to manual queuing. 
c. Improved Accuracy: The digital ticketing system prevents communication errors and order mistakes between customers and stall owners. 
d. Efficient Operations: Stall owners benefit from better order management, leading to smoother and more efficient canteen operations. 
e. Enhanced Experience: The system supports broader digital transformation goals while significantly improving the overall customer experience for students and staff. 
f. Improved Dietary Habits: The customers are able to get the recommended foods based on their health profile and get the recommended foods.

title: Automated Invoice Processor
synopsis:
The Automated Invoice Processor is designed to eliminate the tedious manual entry of roughly 1,000 monthly invoices for the School of Hospitality staff. By using an AI-powered application to automatically extract key details, such as the company name, invoice number, cost, GST and total cost, the project transforms unstructured vendor documents into a clean Excel file. This allows staff to skip the time-consuming typing phase and move straight to the critical verification step. The application also check the retrieved data against system records for accurate Purchase Order submission.

The solution incorporates Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities to intelligently query and validate invoice information, including balances, vendor names, GST values, costs and other financial details. This enhances the accuracy and flexibility of the verification process by enabling natural language checks and contextual understanding of invoice content. The project was developed using a vibe coding approach, leveraging rapid AI-assisted development workflows together with LLM API integrations to accelerate prototyping, implementation and refinement of the application.
shortSynopsis: The Automated Invoice Processor is designed to eliminate the tedious manual entry of roughly 1,000 monthly invoices for the School of Hospitality staff. By using an AI-powered application to automatically extract key details, such as the company name, invoice number, cost, GST and total cost, the project transforms unstructured vendor documents into a clean Excel file.
innovation:
The solution moves beyond conventional OCR and rule-based automation in three distinct ways.

First, it employs a *self-reflective confidence layer* — when the AI agent is uncertain about an extraction, it autonomously escalates to a more capable model (Flash Lite → Flash → Pro) before finalising the result, without any human intervention. This mimics human judgement in a way rigid rule-based systems cannot.

Second, the system is *truly agentic* — it does not simply extract data but orchestrates an end-to-end workflow autonomously: extracting invoice data, validating it, cross-referencing vendor reports, identifying discrepancies, preparing PO-ready records, and triggering exception alerts. Each step is driven by AI decision-making rather than pre-programmed rules.

Third, it handles *unstructured, multi-format supplier invoices without templates* — adapting to varying layouts across different vendors, something traditional automation tools require costly and time-consuming configuration to achieve.

Together, these innovations reframe automation from a passive extraction tool into an active, decision-making agent — a meaningful leap for administrative operations in an educational institution.
benefit:
Significant manhour savings: The system automates invoice data extraction and comparison with vendor reports. Based on 1,000 invoices per month and an average of 3 minutes per invoice, the current process requires approximately 50 manhours per month. Automation allows staff to focus only on invoices with discrepancies, saving about 600 manhours annually.

Elimination of manual transcription errors: The automated workflow removes manual data entry into Excel and eliminates transcription errors caused by human fatigue. This provides consistent and reliable invoice data for Purchase Order processing.

Zero additional operating costs: The application is designed for efficient day-to-day operation, allowing SOH to use the system without additional operating costs for routine invoice processing.

Easy deployment and scalability: Packaged as a portable .exe file, the application requires no complex installation and can be easily deployed to other users or departments.

Better use of staff resources: Staff can focus on exception handling, supplier management, and procurement support instead of repetitive administrative work.

title: AI Operations Agent
synopsis: Smart AI Factory Agent combines AI agents, automation and Digital Twin technology to create an intelligent supervisory platform for industrial operations. Operators can use natural language through chat or web interfaces to monitor equipment, control processes, troubleshoot issues and generate reports. A real-time Digital Twin mirrors the physical factory, enabling users to visualize operations and test scenarios safely. Large Language Models (LLMs) provide contextual reasoning and intelligent workflow orchestration, while AI-assisted development and vibe coding accelerate prototyping and system integration. The project bridges human intent, AI intelligence and physical factory operations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort and support faster decision-making.
shortSynopsis: Smart AI Factory Agent combines AI agents, automation and Digital Twin technology to create an intelligent supervisory platform for industrial operations. Operators can use natural language through chat or web interfaces to monitor equipment, control processes, troubleshoot issues and generate reports.
innovation:
The key innovation of the Smart AI Factory Agent is the integration of Agentic AI, Digital Twin technology and industrial automation into a unified intelligent platform. Unlike a conventional chatbot, the AI Agent can understand user intent, determine the required actions and coordinate factory processes to achieve the desired outcome.
The orchestration layer connects natural-language instructions with industrial operations, enabling users to monitor equipment, control processes, check sensors and generate reports through simple conversations.
A real-time Digital Twin provides a virtual representation of the factory, allowing users to monitor operations, visualize changes and validate scenarios alongside physical processes. LLMs and AI-assisted vibe coding further support intelligent interaction and faster system development.

Key innovations include:

- Agentic AI that transforms user intent into automated actions.
- Integration of LLMs with real industrial systems, beyond a standalone chatbot.
- Real-time synchronization between the physical factory and Digital Twin.
- Natural-language and web-based control of factory operations.
- Intelligent orchestration of multi-step workflows.
- Modular architecture that can be extended to more machines, sensors and processes.
- AI-assisted development for faster prototyping and integration.
benefit:
The Smart AI Factory Agent improves manufacturing efficiency by providing a unified and intelligent way to manage factory operations. Through natural-language commands via Telegram or web interfaces, operators can monitor equipment, control processes, check sensor conditions and generate reports without switching between multiple systems.

By combining real-time factory data with a Digital Twin, operators can visualize operations, identify potential issues and respond more quickly. AI-driven workflow orchestration also automates routine tasks, reduces manual effort and supports faster, more informed decision-making.

Key benefits include:

- Reduces manual effort through intelligent automation.
- Improves operational visibility with real-time Digital Twin monitoring.
- Enables faster and more informed decision-making.
- Reduces human error in repetitive tasks.
- Provides intuitive natural-language interaction with factory systems.
- Supports remote monitoring through web and Telegram interfaces.
- Provides a scalable foundation for future smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 applications.

title: Remote-Controlled Roadside Warning Robot
synopsis: Placing a breakdown warning triangle on expressways or remote roads can expose drivers to unnecessary risk, especially during poor visibility, heavy rain, or when the vehicle is stopped near bends or road crests. Drivers may need to walk along the road shoulder to position the warning triangle, increasing their exposure to approaching traffic. This project proposes a remote-controlled roadside warning robot that allows the driver to deploy and position a warning triangle at a safe distance behind the vehicle without having to walk along the roadside. Mounted on a motorised mobile platform, the robot can be controlled using a handheld remote control or mobile device and positioned approximately 20–50 metres behind the vehicle, with a potential range of up to 100 metres. High-visibility markings and LED lighting improve its visibility during both day and night conditions. Designed for low-speed operation, stable positioning and safe deployment, the prototype provides a practical and user-friendly solution to reduce drivers' exposure to roadside hazards during vehicle breakdowns.
shortSynopsis: Placing a breakdown warning triangle on expressways or remote roads can expose drivers to unnecessary risk, especially during poor visibility, heavy rain, or when the vehicle is stopped near bends or road crests. Drivers may need to walk along the road shoulder to position the warning triangle, increasing their exposure to approaching traffic.
innovation:
The key innovation of the Remote-Controlled Roadside Warning Robot lies in transforming the conventional static warning triangle into an actively deployable mobile safety system. Rather than requiring a driver to physically walk along the roadside to place a warning device, the solution combines a motorised platform, remote-control capability and enhanced visual warning features to allow deployment from a safer distance.

The project addresses a practical safety gap in conventional roadside breakdown procedures. While traditional warning triangles provide an important visual alert, their placement may expose drivers to the very traffic hazard they are attempting to warn others about. By introducing remote mobility, the prototype reduces this exposure while retaining the familiar function of a roadside warning triangle.

Its low-speed and stable operating design prioritises safe deployment rather than speed, making the technology appropriate for roadside emergency applications. The integration of high-visibility markings and LED lighting further extends the effectiveness of the warning system across different lighting and weather conditions.

The innovative features include:

* Conversion of a passive warning triangle into a remotely deployable mobile safety device.
* Remote-controlled positioning that reduces the need for drivers to enter hazardous roadside areas.
* Integration of mobility, visibility and warning functions within a single compact platform.
* Flexible deployment at approximately 20–50 metres, with potential operational range of up to 100 metres.
* Enhanced day-and-night visibility through reflective/high-visibility elements and LED lighting.
* Low-speed operation designed specifically for controlled and safe roadside deployment.
* Potential for future enhancements such as cameras, obstacle detection, autonomous positioning, location tracking and vehicle-to-device connectivity.

The project demonstrates how relatively simple robotics and remote-control technologies can be applied innovatively to solve a real-world road safety problem and reduce human exposure to preventable roadside hazards.
benefit:
The Remote-Controlled Roadside Warning Robot improves driver safety during vehicle breakdowns by reducing the need for drivers to walk along expressways or roadside shoulders to position a warning triangle. This is particularly beneficial during poor visibility, heavy rain, night-time conditions, or when a vehicle has stopped near a bend or road crest where approaching motorists may have limited reaction time.

Using a handheld remote control or mobile device, the driver can deploy and position the warning robot approximately 20–50 metres behind the stationary vehicle while remaining at a safer location. Its high-visibility markings and LED lighting provide additional visual warning to approaching motorists during both day and night conditions.

The solution also improves convenience and response time during emergencies. Instead of manually carrying and positioning a conventional warning triangle, the motorised platform allows the warning device to be moved remotely and repositioned when required.

Overall, the project provides the following benefits:

* Reduces drivers' exposure to moving traffic during roadside emergencies.
* Improves safety during breakdowns on expressways, remote roads and low-visibility locations.
* Enables remote deployment and positioning of the warning triangle.
* Provides enhanced visibility through high-visibility markings and LED lighting.
* Allows the warning device to be repositioned without requiring the driver to return to the roadway.
* Supports operation from a safer location using a handheld remote control or mobile device.

title: LipReading AI
synopsis:
A multimodal AI system that combines motion image analysis for LipReading and Speech-to-Text to explore use-cases for Smart Lock authentication and Smart Classroom transcription. 

While singular model build for static image or speech-to-text in a given language is common now, more advanced tier such as video analysis is still emerging. 

Exploration of AI system combination for multimodal use-cases will be one area that students need to gain early exposure to, in order to build a sense/ intuition for contextual video understanding, embodied AI, and design of future intelligent environments.
shortSynopsis: A multimodal AI system that combines motion image analysis for LipReading and Speech-to-Text to explore use-cases for Smart Lock authentication and Smart Classroom transcription.
innovation:
The engineering design required to convert video to images, detect the face and focus into a small region of the face to extract the subtle lip movement across an extremely short time interval is the challenge. Our solution for it is the innovation. 

The difficulty of the project problem is that it has to setup a stable data processing pipeline that can reliably target a small facial region within seconds and devise a motion signal for subtle movements. This is a whole new level of difficulty compared to a simpler problem of analysising 1-frame still images (which is already mature technology) or analysing large moving objects (which is maturing). The problem-space the team is exploring is detecting of subtle movement in small region space, and this is an emergent area in engineering.

Rounds of design and debugging to understand how to: 
1) capture a few seconds of video (because lip movements are not just covering small region image space, words themselves consists of lip movements happening in seconds)
2) troubleshooting to solve jitter-smoothing (after noticing that re-detecting mouth position on every frame introduced a small tracking jitter which created fake motion signal that corrupts data - humans have minute movements even in seconds)
3) finding a good open-source model for face detection that can also run on edge devices (after a crop locked onto an eyebrow)
4) scaling issues - as a model is trained on more lip movements and words, its accuracy will drop drastically
benefit:
An assistive communication tech to give people who cannot speak reliably another way to express simple needs such as "water", "help", "no". 

Opens up a new security dimension to integrate into smart home devices, for silent commands for doors, lights and emergency systems - providing a silent channel when speaking is unsafe, impossible or impractical (e.g., someone forces you to open your digital house lock - you can tap an extra code with mouth movement "help" to trigger a silent security alert). 

For intelligence needs, it can be an "unusual", "hard to detect" & "less-predictable" access barrier setup in websites or physical sites, allowing entry only to people with awareness of the special combination of visible/audible + non-audible (mouth movement) codes.

title: NEA RAG
synopsis: This project builds a smarter way to search and understand NEA's sustainability reports. By processing NEA annual reports, it organises the information into a connected map of facts and relationships , making it easy to ask questions, spot trends, and uncover insights across the reports, without having to read through everything manually.
shortSynopsis: This project builds a smarter way to search and understand NEA's sustainability reports. By processing NEA annual reports, it organises the information into a connected map of facts and relationships , making it easy to ask questions, spot trends, and uncover insights across the reports, without having to read through everything manually.
innovation: The NEA Knowledge Graph reframes how an AI system engages with organisational knowledge: instead of treating documents as flat text to search (as standard RAG does), it structures multi-modal inputs — reports, CCTV footage, audio logs, sensor readings, and geospatial data — into a connected knowledge graph where entities and their relationships are explicit and traversable. A Graph-RAG layer then lets an LLM convert natural-language questions into Cypher queries, walk the graph's actual causal and organisational connections, and generate answers that are grounded in a specific, auditable path rather than a plausible-sounding guess. This is paired with a dynamic schema that expands automatically as new data types are added, and a full guardrail architecture (input sanitisation, confidence thresholds, source-citation enforcement, audit logging) that makes the system's reasoning transparent and verifiable at every step — turning a black-box AI interaction into a traceable, decision-support tool.
benefit: For NEA, the system converts knowledge that already exists but is unusable — scattered across EMPOWER, eRegistry, shared drives, and institutional memory — into something staff can actually query and act on. Officers who currently spend hours a week hunting across disconnected systems could get grounded answers in seconds, with every claim traceable back to its source documents and entities. Cross-divisional insight that's presently invisible (a Water Division project echoing an issue logged years ago in Environmental Health) becomes discoverable, recurring problems can be spotted before they escalate, and documentation gaps can be flagged proactively ahead of audits rather than after. Beyond day-to-day efficiency, the graph externalises institutional knowledge so it survives staff rotation, and its explainable, human-in-the-loop design directly supports NEA's RMS 2027 goals around knowledge accessibility, connectivity, and responsible AI governance.

title: Senior Guard AI (Edge AI for Safe Aging)
synopsis: Senior Guard AI is an edge-based fall detection system designed to help elderly people who live alone stay safer at home. A Raspberry Pi 5 with a camera runs a custom-trained YOLO vision model in real time to recognise standing, sitting, lying, and falling postures. When a fall is detected, the system raises alerts through a local caregiver dashboard and optional text notifications — without sending video to the cloud. The project addresses a growing need in ageing Singapore: faster response after a fall, while protecting privacy and avoiding subscription-based smart cameras.
shortSynopsis: Senior Guard AI is an edge-based fall detection system designed to help elderly people who live alone stay safer at home. A Raspberry Pi 5 with a camera runs a custom-trained YOLO vision model in real time to recognise standing, sitting, lying, and falling postures.
innovation: Combines student-trained computer vision (YOLOv8) with on-device inference on low-cost edge hardware, so detection runs offline on the local network. Video stays on the Pi; only lightweight status telemetry (position, confidence, alert flag) may be shared optionally. The architecture is designed for a Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ with Hailo acceleration in production, while the current prototype already demonstrates end-to-end detection, live LAN preview, and dashboard monitoring on CPU inference.
benefit: Reduces reliance on cloud cameras that require monthly fees and continuous internet, and avoids uploading sensitive home video. Caregivers and family can monitor status over the local network during demos or home trials, and receive timely fall alerts so help can be dispatched sooner. Supports digital readiness by showing how students can build practical, privacy-preserving AI for community eldercare rather than consumer surveillance products.

shortSynopsis: Primary 1–3 mainstream teachers need support when interacting with students with autism (Level 1, mid- to high-functioning). innovation: IncluTeach integrates generative AI with inclusive education practices to provide teachers with practical, classroom-ready support. shortTitle: LearnLoot – AI Study Companion for Low-GPA Students
synopsis: Students with a GPA of 2.5 and below often struggle to grasp fundamental concepts using conventional study materials. LearnLoot is an AI-powered study tool that reads off the user's own lecture slides and explains concepts in ways that are easier to understand, helping students learn at their own pace and improve their grades.
shortSynopsis: Students with a GPA of 2.5 and below often struggle to grasp fundamental concepts using conventional study materials. LearnLoot is an AI-powered study tool that reads off the user's own lecture slides and explains concepts in ways that are easier to understand, helping students learn at their own pace and improve their grades.
innovation: StudyQuest Arena turns any set of study materials into a living, AI-driven learning system — quiz questions are generated straight from the student's own slides (not generic trivia), automatically tracked by topic/section, and adapted in real time so difficulty rises where the student is strong and ramps up gently where they're weak.
benefit: Students get a personalized, game-like study loop instead of passive reading: AI mentors explain why an answer is right, a strength radar shows exactly which topics need work, and XP, streaks, leaderboards, clans, and mini-games turn repetitive review into something students actually want to come back to.
